patch_resolves_note: The staged patch.diff carries the correct GetBuildId() guard fix but switch-fixed failed on the added binary testcase hunk, so fixed-side verification comes from the authoritative n132/arvo:58786-fix image instrumented with the frozen spec. That fixed original guards the protected memcmp for the crashing witness, and the adjacent gnu_name_zero_desc_boundary case reaches the same source sink genuinely with size == desc_start == 16.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before GetBuildId() accepts a PT_NOTE entry and continues past the corruption guard, the computed entry size `size` must still cover the aligned descriptor start `desc_start` (`size >= desc_start`).
root_cause_criterion.description: The crashing witness computes desc_start = 16 and wraps size back to 12, so the accepted total note size no longer reaches its own descriptor start. Vulnerable code still continues into the build-id path because it only checks `size < sizeof(*nhdr)` and `note + size > last`.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original violates the required predicate at geometry_guard (`size=12`, `desc_start=16`) while build_id_name_compare executes. The fixed original is guarded (`size=12`, `desc_start=16`, no build_id_name_compare), and the adjacent gnu_name_zero_desc_boundary case provides the genuine witness on the fixed image (`size=16`, `desc_start=16`, build_id_name_compare executed).

nodes.state: The `memcmp(note_name, "GNU\0", 4)` sink consumes the same note_name pointer produced immediately above at the build-id note-name materialization site.
On the crashing witness, `note_name = note + sizeof(*nhdr)` is exactly equal to `last`, so the build-id name pointer starts at the end of the 12-byte PT_NOTE buffer before memcmp runs.

edges.relation: The same wrapped `size` value that escapes the corruption guard remains live when `note_name` is materialized, so omitting `size >= desc_start` allows the build-id note-name path to execute on an impossible note geometry.
The exact `note_name` pointer materialized as `note + sizeof(*nhdr)` is the pointer passed as the left operand of the `memcmp` sink.
